snippet.title: NINJA GAIDEN 4 - 'The Two Masters' Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
NINJA GAIDEN 4's “The Two Masters” DLC is now available! "The Two Masters" adds three all-new chapters to NINJA GAIDEN 4’s campaign. Players can also access two new weapons, Yakumo’s “Solitaire” scythe and Ryu’s “Jakotsumon” Serpent Gauntlets to unleash devastation against new enemies, in new trials, and in an all-new Abyssal Road challenge mode.

Play now on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, and Xbox Cloud.

WHERE SHADOWS FALL, LEGENDS RISE. 

The definitive ninja action-adventure franchise returns with NINJA GAIDEN 4! Embark on a cutting-edge adventure where legacy meets innovation in a high-octane blend of style and no-holds-barred combat.
